cats.title: What you can predict
cats.sub: Every market states the question, how it is resolved and which sources are used
cats.footballD: Match result and goal totals in major leagues; betting closes 5 minutes before kick-off.
cats.nbaD: Winner and total points; settles automatically when two score sources agree.
cats.cryptoD: One-hour up/down markets on BTC and other coins, opened on a fixed schedule (for example one session a day at 13:00 UTC) and resolved automatically from Binance and OKX candles; they settle only when both sources agree.
cats.macroD: Rate decisions, inflation data and more, resolved from official releases with a 24-hour dispute window.

steps.title: Pari-mutuel in three steps
steps.s1d: Each market lists the question, options, closing time and resolution source.
steps.s2d: Your stake joins that option’s pool. Bet any time before close; bets can’t be cancelled.
steps.s3d: After the result, losing stakes are shared among winners by stake; payouts go to your balance, ready to withdraw.

fee.title: Clear fees: only a fee on profit (5% by default)
fee.sub: No fee on stakes or losses; cancelled or voided markets are refunded in full
fee.note: Based on the example market’s current pool; the final pool at close decides. Each market’s fee is in its rules and every change is published.

safe.title: Funds and results you can check
safe.s1d: Every account has its own USDT deposit address (ERC20, TRC20, BEP20), credited after on-chain confirmation.
safe.s2d: Withdraw only to whitelisted addresses; new addresses activate after 24 hours, and every withdrawal has a cooling-off period and review.
safe.s3d: We don’t make markets or bet against you. In every market payouts + fees + rounding = pool, reconciled daily.
safe.s4d: Settled markets show the result, evidence, time and resolver ID; platform-resolved results are published first and can be disputed.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: How are odds calculated? Do they change?
faq.a1: Probability = the option’s pool ÷ the total pool; estimated multiplier = 1 + (total ÷ option pool − 1) × (1 − fee). Odds move as people bet and are fixed when betting closes.
faq.q2: How does the platform make money? Is it betting against me?
faq.a2: We only take a fee on winners’ profit after the result (5% by default). There is no house and no market making; money moves only between bettors.
faq.q3: Who decides results? What if they are wrong?
faq.a3: Crypto up/down and scores are resolved automatically from two data sources. Other markets are resolved by the platform, published for review and open to disputes. Evidence and resolver IDs are always public.
faq.q4: Which networks are supported? How long do withdrawals take?
faq.a4: USDT only (ERC20, TRC20, BEP20). Withdrawals have a 2-hour cooling-off period, then review and on-chain transfer. Minimum 100 USDT; identity verification required.
